points: \item Architected and deployed a self-correcting RAG system using LangChain and Mistral 7B for AI-enhanced DevSecOps workflows, improving documentation accuracy by ~20% and enabling automated security policy generation for containerized applications.

\item Engineered AI-assisted CI/CD pipelines integrating large language models with GitHub Actions for automated code generation, security compliance, and infrastructure-as-code templates based on fintech best practices.

\item Developed LLM-as-Judge evaluation framework to assess code quality, security risks, and compliance across hundreds of pull requests, ensuring production-grade reliability with AI-powered review summaries and risk assessments.

\item Optimized development velocity through AI coding assistants and batched query workflows, reducing manual refactoring time by ~80% and accelerating secure containerization of legacy applications with automated unit testing.

\item Designed ML-based anomaly detection system for log analysis and troubleshooting, reducing incident response time by 25% while maintaining security posture and enabling faster issue resolution with AI-powered diagnostics.

\item Implemented CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions to automate model retraining, testing, and deployment to AWS with Docker containerization, ensuring reliable and repeatable ML releases with Agile team collaboration.
